title: Button
description: In-page action control with one primary action per screen, loading state, and native button type.

details.when: Trigger an in-page action. Use Link (or Button asChild with an anchor) for navigation.
details.content: Label states the action (保存, 削除). An icon-only action uses IconButton with aria-label.

behavior.type: Defaults to type="button"; pass type="submit" for the form's submit action.
behavior.pending: Use loading while a request is in flight: it disables activation, sets aria-busy, and shows a spinner.
behavior.priority: variant defaults to primary, so every additional Button in a screen needs an explicit lower-emphasis variant.
